InlineInATurn.note: Mentions inline in two assistant paragraphs — the GitHub mark sits on the text baseline at one line-height and the link tone reads against chat body copy. Only GitHub hosts are used: see the file header, the favicon path needs network and the capture runs offline.

MentionList.note: Four stacked GitHub mentions (pull, releases, gist subdomain) showing the icon shell's fixed width and the shared link tone.

NonUrlFallbacks.note: The plain-link branch: a relative workspace path, an in-page anchor and a mailto: each render with the shared link treatment and no icon, next to a real external mention for contrast. LIMITATION: the non-GitHub favicon path is UNVERIFIED — it fetches https://<host>/favicon.ico, which the offline capture cannot resolve.
